summary: TOYO Co., Ltd, a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K covering its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The document contains routine financial results, warrant schedules, restricted stock and share-based compensation details for employees, consultants, and directors, and references a prior reverse recapitalization. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is announced. This is an ordinary periodic report under the 1934 Act, with no transactional terms or board recommendations. The filing is informational only, and no risk-arb or deal-related watch items apply.
